description: This file configures translations, tab registration, and widget setup for the 'behaviors' feature within an Allure-based UI framework, supporting multiple languages and specifying UI components and routes.

classes.name: allure.components.TreeLayout
classes.description: A UI component for displaying a hierarchical layout related to test groups and results.

classes.name: allure.components.WidgetStatusView
classes.description: A widget component that displays the status view for behaviors, extending a base Widget class.

methods.name: allure.api.addTranslation
methods.description: Adds a translation object for a specified language code, containing localized strings for tabs and widgets.

methods.name: allure.api.addTab
methods.description: Registers a new tab in the UI, with route, icon, title, and initialization logic including creating layout components.

methods.name: allure.api.addWidget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the UI with specified configurations, including title, base URL, and visibility options.
